# KaTeX runtime subset

This directory vendors the browser distribution from KaTeX 0.18.7. It keeps
`katex.min.js`, `katex.min.css`, and the WOFF2 fonts referenced by the CSS so
formula rendering remains fully local. KaTeX is distributed under the MIT
license; see `LICENSE` in this directory.

Upstream: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX
